name: Domain search
oneLiner: a dark glass domain search types the brand domain, Search is pressed, the result card rises with a spinner that flips to a green Available chip, Add to cart is pressed and turns green, and the domain flies up into the cart as the badge pops
say: when the speaker says they grabbed the name or bought the domain ('first thing I did was buy the domain'): the domain types on the name, Available goes green and it drops into the cart on 'bought it'
